transport_framing_protocols.name: Abridged Transport
transport_framing_protocols.description: Ultra-compact framing protocol with 1 to 4 bytes length header. Highest payload-to-overhead ratio.
transport_framing_protocols.length_encoding: If length / 4 < 127: single byte (length / 4). If length / 4 >= 127: byte 0x7f followed by 3 bytes little-endian (length / 4).

transport_framing_protocols.name: Intermediate Transport
transport_framing_protocols.description: Standard 4-byte length framing used as the default for stable TCP connections across modern Telegram mobile apps.
transport_framing_protocols.length_encoding: 4-byte little-endian signed 32-bit integer representing exact payload byte length.

transport_framing_protocols.name: Padded Intermediate Transport
transport_framing_protocols.description: Obfuscated framing appending 0 to 15 random padding bytes to every packet, eliminating distinctive packet size signatures for DPI firewall evasion.

transport_framing_protocols.name: Full TCP Transport
transport_framing_protocols.description: Full framing with built-in data integrity verification and packet loss detection.
